name: Lavalink-Server
description: Standalone Lavalink v4 audio server with YouTube and Spotify plugins.

LAVA_PASS.description: Password used by Discord bots to authenticate with this Lavalink server

YOUTUBE_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: YouTube OAuth 2.0 refresh token for authenticated playback

YOUTUBE_API_KEY.description: Optional YouTube Data API v3 key

YOUTUBE_CIPHER_URL.description: Remote cipher endpoint for YouTube signature deciphering

YOUTUBE_CIPHER_PASSWORD.description: Optional password for self-hosted yt-cipher (leave empty for default public endpoint)

KEEP_ALIVE_ENABLED.description: Ping /health every 10 minutes to prevent cloud sleep throttling
